authors.bio: Antonio Argibay, AIA, is a founding principal of Meridian Design, an award-winning architecture, planning and design firm headquartered in New York City with offices in Miami and Geneva, Switzerland. The company has a broad practice, which includes many Entertainment and Media clients such as Time Warner, CNN, Telemundo, Lifetime, HBO, ABC, NBC, ESPN and CBS. Their work for Lifetime was voted the “Best Workspace in America” in 2007 by Reader's Digest in the “Design & Style” category. Argibay and Meridian's work have been featured in Broadcast Engineering, The New York Times, The New York Post, The New York Daily News, EFE News, TV y Video, and other leading national and international trade and consumer publications. He has also authored many technical articles on content capture spaces, acoustics and facilities' workflow. Argibay received Bachelor and Master's degrees from Pratt Institute. He presented papers at NAB in 1993, 1996, and 2010 and was part of a panel in NAB 2009 “Going Green and Seeing Black.”
